module origen_034521 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire resetn,
    input wire x,
    input wire y,
    output reg f,
    output reg g
);

    // State encoding
    parameter IDLE = 4'b0000;
    parameter F0   = 4'b0001;
    parameter F1   = 4'b0010;
    parameter X0   = 4'b0011;
    parameter X1   = 4'b0100;
    parameter X2   = 4'b0101;
    parameter Y0   = 4'b0110;
    parameter Y1   = 4'b0111;
    parameter Y00  = 4'b1000;
    parameter Y01  = 4'b1001;

    reg [3:0] cstate, nstate;

    // State register
    always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
        if (!resetn)
            cstate <= IDLE;
        else
            cstate <= nstate;
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (cstate)
            IDLE: nstate = F0;
            F0:   nstate = F1;
            F1:   nstate = x ? X0 : F1;
            X0:   nstate = x ? X0 : X1;
            X1:   nstate = x ? X2 : F1;
            X2:   nstate = y ? Y1 : Y0;
            Y0:   nstate = y ? Y01 : Y00;
            Y1:   nstate = Y1;
            Y00:  nstate = Y00;
            Y01:  nstate = Y01;
            default: nstate = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(*) begin
        f = (cstate == F0);
        g = (cstate == X2) || (cstate == Y1) || (cstate == Y0) || (cstate == Y01);
    end

endmodule
